final_strategy.rationale: Archive-evidence tracks the WU code commit at HEAD~1 (stable across doc amendments). The doc itself does NOT track its own SHA — that would be a chicken-and-egg loop. The "evidence_commit" field captures the most recent doc commit for audit, and any future reader can verify by running `git log -1 -- docs/...` from the WU commit to see the doc history.
